Bihar Public Service Commission is a government agency responsible for conducting recruitment exams for various government posts in Bihar, India.

The Bihar BPSC District Statistical Officer DSO programme is a government job opportunity for master degree holders in Statistics / Mathematics / Economics.
The programme aims to recruit eligible candidates for the post of District Statistical Officer/Assistant Director in the Planning & Development Department, Government of Bihar.
